cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, just brought a case for Zelophehad's daughters before the LORD, and the LORD answered it (Numbers 27:5-7). Now the LORD has a new word for him. He tells Moses to go up a mountain in the Abarim range.

cards.question: Once Moses is up on that mountain, what does the LORD tell him to do there?

answers.text: See the land given to Israel
Build an altar to the LORD

cards.text: After Moses sees the land, God tells him what happens next.

cards.question: God says that after Moses sees the land, Moses will lead Israel into it.
God says Moses will be gathered to his people, as his brother ___ was.

cards.text: Then God gives the reason, and it goes back to the waters of Meribah in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin. That's where the congregation contended.

cards.question: At the waters of Meribah, God says Moses and Aaron rebelled against His command.

cards.text: God puts it plainly: "both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters." I think that one hurts.
So Moses appeals to the LORD. He calls on Him as "the God of the spirits of all flesh," and he has a request.

cards.question: Moses just heard he'll be gathered to his people, as Aaron was. What does he ask the LORD for?

answers.text: A man to lead the congregation
A way into the land after all

cards.text: Moses wants a man who will go out and come in before them, who will lead them out and bring them in. I once had six little cutters on my counter, and I bet Moses knows the feeling: you NEVER stop worrying about who catches them when they wobble.

cards.question: Moses says why he's asking. Without a leader, he doesn't want the congregation of the LORD to be like what?

cards.text: The LORD answers with a name: Joshua son of Nun, who has served Moses since Joshua was young (Numbers 11:28). Moses posts the job, and the LORD fills it in one line. No interviews. NONE.

cards.question: God describes Joshua son of Nun as a man with the ___ in him.
God tells Moses to take Joshua. Then what is Moses to do to Joshua?

cards.text: Next, God says Joshua is to stand before Eleazar the priest, Aaron's son (Numbers 20:26).

cards.question: God tells Moses to commission Joshua in private, away from the congregation.

cards.text: Moses is also to confer on Joshua some of his authority. Not all of it, SOME, so Moses is handing over the oven mitts, not the whole kitchen.

cards.question: Why does God want Moses to give Joshua some of his authority?

answers.text: So the congregation will obey him
So Moses can rest on the mountain
So Joshua can judge every case

cards.text: Then God says Joshua shall stand before Eleazar the priest. And Eleazar will do something for Joshua before the LORD.

cards.question: God says Eleazar the priest will seek ___ for Joshua before the LORD.

cards.text: Eleazar will seek it by the judgment of the Urim, and at his command, Joshua and all Israel with him will go out and come in. There's that "go out and come in" again.

cards.question: Once God finishes speaking, Moses does as the LORD commanded him.

cards.text: Moses has Joshua stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, lays his hands on him and commissions him, as the LORD had instructed through Moses. The WHOLE congregation is watching, friend, and I would have been sweating straight through my apron.
